preconditions.expression: t == int(stdin.split()[0]) and t >= 1 and t <= 100
preconditions.description: The first line of input is a single integer t (1 ≤ t ≤ 100) representing the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression: all(5 <= int(line.split()[0]) <= 500 for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and line.split()[0].isdigit() and int(line.split()[0]) == n)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the first line after t is an integer n (5 ≤ n ≤ 500) representing the size of the arrays.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == n for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and not line.split()[0].isdigit())
preconditions.description: Each of the 2n lines following n contains exactly n integers, representing a permutation of integers from 1 to n.

preconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= int(x) <= n for x in line.split()) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and not line.split()[0].isdigit())
preconditions.description: Each element in the arrays is an integer between 1 and n (inclusive).

preconditions.expression: all(len(set(line.split())) == n for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and not line.split()[0].isdigit())
preconditions.description: Each array is a permutation of integers from 1 to n (no duplicates).

preconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == n for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and not line.split()[0].isdigit())
preconditions.description: Each array has exactly n elements.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip().split() and all(line.strip() for line in stdout.strip().splitlines())
postconditions.description: The output consists of non-empty lines for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == 2 for line in stdout.strip().splitlines() if line.strip())
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output consists of exactly two lines: the first line is the count of good subsets modulo 998244353, and the second line is a list of n indices (1-based) forming a good subset.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(count_line.split()[0]) <= 998244352 for count_line in stdout.strip().splitlines() if count_line.strip() and count_line.split()[0].isdigit())
postconditions.description: The first line of each test case's output is a non-negative integer representing the count of good subsets modulo 998244353.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(idx) <= 2 * n for idx in indices_line.split()) and len(indices_line.split()) == n for indices_line in stdout.strip().splitlines() if not indices_line.split()[0].isdigit() and indices_line.strip()
postconditions.description: The second line of each test case's output is a list of n distinct indices (1-based) from 1 to 2n, representing a good subset.

postconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= arr[line_idx - 1][col_idx - 1] <= n for col_idx in range(1, n + 1)) for line_idx in indices_line.split()) and all(len(set(arr[line_idx - 1])) == n for line_idx in indices_line.split()) for indices_line in stdout.strip().splitlines() if not indices_line.split()[0].isdigit() and indices_line.strip()
postconditions.description: The selected subset of arrays forms a Latin square: for each column index 1 ≤ i ≤ n, the i-th elements of the selected arrays form a permutation of integers from 1 to n.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(idx) <= 2 * n for idx in indices_line.split()) and len(set(indices_line.split())) == n for indices_line in stdout.strip().splitlines() if not indices_line.split()[0].isdigit() and indices_line.strip()
postconditions.description: The indices in the second line of each test case are distinct and within the valid range.
